title: Private Banff Town, Lake Louise & Minnewanka Tour - From Calgary
blurb:
THE EXPERIENCE:
Designed as the quintessential introduction to the Canadian Rockies, this itinerary trades our usual emphasis on hiking for a curated selection of the region's most legendary landmarks and some afternoon free time to explore Banff town. From alpine lakes to the charming streets of Banff, this is a sightseeing-focused journey where the views are grand and the walking is gentle.

- Private tour (max. 11 guests)
- Duration: ~10 hrs
- Door-to-door transport from anywhere in Calgary, with park passes included
- Picnic lunch and refreshments provided
- Difficulty: Easy.

ABOUT MOLARI:
As a family-run boutique, we prioritize a safe, ethical, and immersive approach to sharing the beauty of Western Canada:

- Private, tailored experiences only
- Founder-led journeys – your guide isn't "just here for the season"
- Our van: high-roof design, all-wheel drive, and remote start AC/heat
- Fully licensed, insured, and permitted.
